goal.name: JEE Advanced
goal.valid_for: JEE Advanced preparation for 2027 using the official 2026 syllabus as the confirmed baseline; recheck when the 2027 syllabus is published.
goal.video_language_note: Mostly Hinglish, with English notes and selected English alternatives. Inherited language tags and teacher distinctions still require human review.
goal.resource_policy: Links only to free, legal sources (official bodies, open-licence textbooks, reputable free platforms, public YouTube videos). No copyrighted PDFs re-hosted. YouTube videos are never paywalled or ad-gated. Official SATHEE pages supplement rationalised NCERT gaps. Older lecture exam-year labels do not determine syllabus coverage; use each topic scope.

estimated_hours.note: Video minutes are real YouTube durations with the +15% rule applied (see goal.last_link_check). Mocks and the revision allowance remain planning figures.

goal.weightage_note: H/M/L are provisional curriculum priorities, not claimed paper-frequency measurements. Reused foundation labels and M defaults for additions need a current paper-analysis review.
goal.verification_note: Schema and structural checks performed locally. Browser research confirmed syllabus, archive and chapter-bank pages. A complete live check, YouTube API metadata and human subject review remain pending; unverified does not mean broken.
goal.prerequisite_note: Shared foundations are embedded from the existing JEE Main file for standalone use. Existing courses are unchanged. The full Main course is not an extra mandatory dependency.
goal.exam_note: Both papers are mandatory under the 2026 baseline. Do not hardcode a universal question count or marking scheme. AAT is a separate exam and is outside this goal.
